record.body:
## Rationale

One file per screen means a reader opens one module to follow one loader. Its view types and private helpers sit beside it.

## Counter-argument

Shared helpers pull the modules together, and records.py can grow into a second model.py. A layer split makes dependencies run one way.

payload.choice: Split model.py by loader: snapshot, task, phase, journal
